requirements.question: Where are sanctions designations, export-control rule changes, or price and currency shocks putting economic stress on a country, a supply chain or a market?
What have the highest national courts and the international courts decided, as each court publishes its decisions?
Which entities, financial facilitators, or shadow-fleet tankers (IMO/MMSI) have been added to OFAC SDN or allied sanctions lists in the past 7 days?
Which BIS, USTR, or OFAC Federal Register rules or stays have upcoming effective dates or public-inspection filings within 30 days?
Is the FAO Food Price Index or one of its sub-indices moving outside its own range of monthly changes?
Do newly designated OFAC vessels match MMSI tracks or loitering anomalies observed by Wake?
Has a staying or superseding document been placed on Federal Register public inspection ahead of an automatic rule reimposition date?
Which currencies or energy benchmarks moved outside their own range of five-day changes?
In which watched countries are local market food prices rising or falling outside the country's own range of three-month changes?
Are fertilizer prices, or the prices of metals on the US critical minerals list, moving outside their own range of monthly changes?
